request: Issue #408: ed28 [ENHANCE] Remove automatic startup trigger for the Spec-Driven Development flow. Goal: start Spec-Driven Development flow only when the user explicitly instructs it. Scope: review flow startup conditions; remove automatic flow/direct-edit selection confirmations for ordinary requests including feature additions, fixes, investigations, and consultations; standardize AGENTS.md and skill metadata wording so it does not depend on a specific client or execution environment. Expected result: ordinary utterances such as please fix this, please implement this, or I want to discuss something do not trigger flow selection confirmation; flow can still be started manually; suggestions are allowed when useful but automatic startup is not.
